annotations.title: Archive and remove a canonical rule

description: Destructive, but safe by default: previews the impact unless dryRun is false, requires confirm: true to delete, archives the rule, and prunes only banner-tagged generated files. Undo with syncytium_restore.

confirm.description: Must be true with dryRun:false to actually delete.

dryRun.description: Preview the impact without changing anything (default).

name: syncytium_remove_rule
